items.name: churn-renewal-risk
items.title: Churn and Renewal Risk
items.description: Churn and renewal risk scanner via Connect CRM and Stripe that Slack-digests Healthy/Watch/At-risk movers and drafts HITL CRM save plays without auto-emailing customers.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: Churn and Renewal Risk is an eve agent that reads HubSpot or Salesforce accounts whose renewal date falls in a lookahead window. It loads Stripe payment health through Vercel Connect, buckets Healthy, Watch, and At-risk, and waits for you before any CRM note.

You interact with it through environment variables and Slack. Set a HubSpot or Salesforce Connect UID, a Stripe Connect UID, and Slack Connect, then trigger churn-renewal-scan. The agent previews every digest and only posts when confirmSend is true. CRM notes stay behind draft_save_play.

It is useful when renewal owners want a movers digest without auto-email. Fail-closed Stripe lookups stay unscored. At-risk rows become a save-play note only after Eve approval. The append-only audit log records scored, delivered, approved, written, and refused.
howItWorks: On the churn-renewal-scan schedule (cron from CHURN_RENEWAL_CRON, default Monday 08:00 UTC), the agent loads the churn-renewal skill.
It calls load_renewal_config and stops when a HubSpot or Salesforce Connect UID, Stripe Connect, or Slack delivery is missing.
scan_renewal_accounts mints a Vercel Connect token and lists renewal-window companies or accounts. That tool is read-only and never writes a note.

load_stripe_health looks up payment signals. Missing or invalid customers fail closed. score_renewal_risk then buckets Healthy, Watch, and At-risk and writes the snapshot into the append-only audit log.

If there are movers, the agent calls preview_renewal_digest, then deliver_renewal_digest with confirmSend true. That tool pauses for Eve approval before the Slack Connect channel. The cron path does not call draft_save_play.
Four evals cover never-write-without-confirm, fail-closed health, never auto-email the customer, and a cron path that stays read-only.

useCases.title: Past-due Stripe, At-risk mover
useCases.body: A HubSpot company renews in forty days and Stripe marks the customer delinquent. score_renewal_risk buckets At-risk. Slack lists the mover. draft_save_play writes a company note only after you approve with confirmWrite true.

useCases.title: Healthy last week, Watch this week
useCases.body: A Salesforce account was Healthy on the prior audit snapshot. Renewal is now nine days out. The score moves to Watch. deliver_renewal_digest posts that mover after confirmSend and Eve approval.

useCases.title: Missing Stripe customer fails closed
useCases.body: An account has a renewal date but no Stripe customer id. load_stripe_health returns failClosed. The account is not scored Healthy. No save-play note is invented.

useCases.title: Monday cron, Slack review
useCases.body: Set CHURN_RENEWAL_CRON to Monday mornings and Slack Connect. Operators get one movers digest in the Eve Slack channel. The cron path stops after deliver_renewal_digest. Notes wait for chat plus approval.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: A model credential for the deployment, either a Vercel AI Gateway API key or AI Gateway OIDC, so the agent can call zai/glm-5.2.

requirements.name: CRM_PROVIDER
requirements.body: Optional force of hubspot or salesforce. When empty, the first complete Connect UID wins.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_CRON
requirements.body: 5-field cron for churn-renewal-scan. Defaults to 0 8 * * 1 (Monday 08:00 UTC on Vercel).

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS
requirements.body: Days ahead to include CRM accounts by renewal date. Defaults to 90.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_MAX_ACCOUNTS
requirements.body: Maximum renewal-window accounts to read per scan. Defaults to 100.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_AUDIT_PATH
requirements.body: Append-only JSONL audit log. Defaults to .data/churn-renewal-audit.jsonl. Stores identifiers and buckets only. Use a durable volume if the app filesystem is ephemeral.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
requirements.body: Days to keep audit rows. Defaults to 90. score_renewal_risk purges older rows.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SLACK_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect Slack connector UID for the Eve Slack channel. Required with the channel id before deliver_renewal_digest will post.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID
requirements.body: Slack channel id for the movers digest. Required with the Slack Connect UID.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_HUBSPOT_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect HubSpot connector UID from vercel connect create hubspot. Mints crm.objects.companies.read, crm.objects.companies.write, and crm.objects.notes.write. Notes still require draft_save_play after Eve approval.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_HUBSPOT_RENEWAL_PROPERTY
requirements.body: HubSpot company date property used as the renewal window. Defaults to renewal_date.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_HUBSPOT_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PROPERTY
requirements.body: HubSpot company property that stores the Stripe customer id. Defaults to stripe_customer_id.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SALESFORCE_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect Salesforce connector UID from vercel connect create salesforce. Mints api and refresh_token.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL
requirements.body: HTTPS Salesforce instance URL required when the provider is salesforce.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SALESFORCE_RENEWAL_FIELD
requirements.body: Salesforce Account date field used as the renewal window. Defaults to Renewal_Date__c.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_SALESFORCE_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_FIELD
requirements.body: Salesforce Account field that stores the Stripe customer id. Defaults to Stripe_Customer_Id__c.

requirements.name: CHURN_RENEWAL_STRIPE_CONNECT_UID
requirements.body: Vercel Connect Stripe connector UID from vercel connect create stripe. Mints read_only. Health lookups never write Stripe.

requirements.name: @vercel/connect
requirements.body: Runtime dependency that mints HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, and Slack tokens through getTokenResponse and connectSlackCredentials. Slack posts with Eve callSlackApi after approval.

faqs.question: How do I install and run a weekly scan?
faqs.answer: Install with npx shadcn@latest add @evex/churn-renewal-risk, copy .env.example, set HubSpot or Salesforce Connect, Stripe Connect, and Slack, then POST to /eve/v1/dev/schedules/churn-renewal-scan while iterating.

faqs.question: Does the cron path write to the CRM?
faqs.answer: No. churn-renewal-scan reads, scores, and may deliver a Slack digest after approval. draft_save_play is the only write path and is not called on cron. confirmWrite must be true after a later Eve approval.

faqs.question: Does it ever email the customer?
faqs.answer: No. There is no email tool. SMTP and send URLs are refused in code. Slack is the only outbound notify, and only for the movers digest after confirmSend and Eve approval.

faqs.question: What happens when Stripe health is missing?
faqs.answer: load_stripe_health fail-closes when the customer id is missing, invalid, or the Stripe lookup fails. score_renewal_risk leaves that account unscored. It is never invented as Healthy.

faqs.question: How do I approve a save play?
faqs.answer: Review the Slack digest, then call draft_save_play with the account, bucket, and confirmWrite true. The tool always pauses for Eve approval. Without that grant the CRM client refuses POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE.
